nodes.summary: Declare the rates persistence contract.
nodes.instructions: Declare the rates table and the repository operations needed by loading, statistics, currencies, effective-date rates, and history. Preserve rate values as text and use the configured persistence library.
nodes.name: Declare the rates persistence contract.

nodes.summary: Declare the rates persistence contract.
nodes.instructions: Declare the rates table and the repository operations needed by loading, statistics, currencies, effective-date rates, and history. Preserve rate values as text and use the configured persistence library.
nodes.name: Declare the rates persistence contract.

acceptance.intent: The rates upsert operation replaces an existing date and currency rate and returns the stored row.
Effective-date lookup returns stored rows on or before its bound in descending date order.
Date lookup returns the stored rows for the requested date.
Currency history returns matching rows in ascending date order within its inclusive bounds.
The rates list operation reads back all rows created by the criterion in declared date and currency order.

nodes.summary: Initialize the rates database through the CLI.
nodes.instructions: Implement `fxrates init` to drop and recreate the rates table as empty. Provide command help and usage behavior.
nodes.name: Initialize the rates database through the CLI.

nodes.summary: Validate and atomically load ECB history files.
nodes.instructions: Implement `fxrates load <csv>` with complete-file validation before writes, exact published rate text, N/A skipping, replacement by date and currency, atomic rejection, operational and usage exit codes, and date and rate totals. Use the staged fixtures as test inputs.
nodes.name: Validate and atomically load ECB history files.

nodes.summary: Serve health, database statistics, and currencies.
nodes.instructions: Implement the health, statistics, and ascending currencies endpoints. Derive all totals and date bounds from persisted rates.
nodes.name: Serve health, database statistics, and currencies.

nodes.summary: Resolve rates on an effective publication date.
nodes.instructions: Return all stored rates on the latest publication date on or before a valid requested date. Return not found when no publication exists and validate malformed dates.
nodes.name: Resolve rates on an effective publication date.

nodes.summary: Report currency history and summary statistics.
nodes.instructions: Return ascending date and rate points for the inclusive optional date range, with count, minimum, maximum, and a six-place half-even mean. Empty periods return no points and null statistics.
nodes.name: Report currency history and summary statistics.

nodes.summary: Convert amounts between currencies.
nodes.instructions: Implement exact Decimal conversion using effective publication dates, with half-even rounding at the specified rate and result boundaries. Validate required parameters, amounts, dates, and currency availability.
nodes.name: Convert amounts between currencies.

nodes.summary: Fetch and load ECB reference-rate history.
nodes.instructions: Download the ECB ZIP archive, extract `eurofxref-hist.csv`, and load it with the same validation and reporting behavior as the file loader. The test suite must stub the download and make no network connection.
nodes.name: Fetch and load ECB reference-rate history.

nodes.summary: Provide the offline automated test runner.
nodes.instructions: Provide POSIX-compatible `bin/test.sh` to run the pytest suite from the application root and return success only when all tests pass. Ensure fetch tests replace the downloader with a stub.
nodes.name: Provide the offline automated test runner.

nodes.summary: Run the supplied end-to-end grader.
nodes.instructions: Run the supplied grader as the terminal verification gate after every implementation story is complete; require its successful exit status.
nodes.name: Run the supplied end-to-end grader.
